name: Solana mainnet RPC node operated by the organisation or a contracted processor (setting solana_rpc_url)
operator: The organisation running V3LUM, or a processor under contract with it (setting solana_rpc_url)
tier_rationale: Node operated by the company or a contracted processor (A12 semantics for 'internal' platforms); P215 FC1 asks for a configurable Solana RPC with the public api.mainnet-beta.solana.com as the default.

reliability.justification: Own (or contracted) mainnet node: ledger facts, as fresh as the node's sync state.

error_markers.reason: Configured Solana RPC (solana_rpc_url): rate limited (JSON-RPC error 429): could not verify
Configured Solana RPC (solana_rpc_url): the call or its parameters are disabled (JSON-RPC error 410): could not verify

rpc.title: Configured Solana mainnet JSON-RPC (getBalance and getSignaturesForAddress only)

terms.quote: getBalance and getSignaturesForAddress (limit <= 25) on a configurable Solana RPC (default api.mainnet-beta.solana.com)

rpc.notes: Quote: binding council text (P215 FC1). Solana validator/RPC software (Agave) is Apache-2.0 and runs on infrastructure the organisation operates or contracts: no third party receives the address. https URL with a host name only (hosts_from_settings): IP literals, userinfo, fragments, devnet/testnet hosts and URLs carrying a credential (api-key query parameters, long path tokens of keyed commercial RPCs) are refused by the module (SKIPPED config); keyed commercial RPCs need their own provider fragment (key-terms) - docs/backlog/p3-G09-2.md.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G09-2 (P215 solana_rpc). Virtual internal provider: its host comes from the https URL setting solana_rpc_url only; without it the module uses the public solana_foundation.rpc source. A configured node is used exclusively (no failover to the public RPC).
